result.description: Cloud observability and security platform: metrics, logs, APM traces, monitors, dashboards, incidents, and more.
result.auth_detail: Public REST API: API key (write/submit) plus application key (read/manage), both created by each customer in their own org; app keys can be scoped. OAuth2 clients exist but are registered from a Datadog Partner Sandbox account via the Developer Platform.
result.access_detail: Each end user creates their own API key and application key in their org; no app review or partner status is needed for that path. Free trial exists, and a Free tier (5 Basic hosts) after the trial. The pricing page text read does not restrict API access by plan. The API/app key path is the one that counts; OAuth needs partner sandbox and publishing, so it is optional. Gate-audit caveat: the middle of the pricing page (about chars 40k-140k) was not read, so a paid-plan API restriction is not fully ruled out.
result.api_notes: Large v1/v2 REST API covering metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents, SLOs, synthetics, security, users/roles, keys, and more. It is multi-site: the base URL varies by Datadog site (US1, US3, US5, EU, AP1, AP2, ...). Official client SDKs exist.

evidence.quote: Requests that read data require full access and also require an application key .
Within your Datadog Partner Sandbox Account, create and configure your OAuth client in the [Developer Platform].
If you have the [permission] to create application keys, click New Key.
On the Free tier, you get up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention, at no cost.
Requests that write data require reporting access and require an API key .
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents that support the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)].
The app authenticates with your Datadog organization through an OAuth flow.
